name: Rossford Public Library, 720 Dixie Hwy
refs: refs/w637393360/00 (Rossford Public Library, February 2021, Wikimedia Commons)
notes: Single-storey red-brick library with a white metal fascia and flat roof, a glazed entrance under a deep flat canopy, clerestory glass band, and a round drum reading room with tall windows and a stacked white roof ring.
